name: aurora_get_state
description: Returns Aurora's current symbolic system state including vector state, lockpoint, ethics protocol, active modules, and layer flags. Use this as the first call to orient any Aurora session.

include_echochain.description: Include EchoChain loop details in response (default: true)

name: aurora_get_agents
description: Returns the Aurora agent PAT registry. Lists all active agents with their role, current PAT visibility status (Available/DND/Invisible), and specialty. Use to understand who is reachable in the current session.

visibility_filter.description: Filter agents by PAT visibility (default: all)

name: aurora_get_drift
description: Returns current drift readings for all three architectural layers against their stratified thresholds (L1=0.002 capsule, L2=0.02 agent/QGIA, L3=0.1 macro/network). Reports any active threshold breaches. See docs/dev-notes/drift-threshold-stratification.md for full rationale.

include_history.description: Include last 5 drift readings per layer (default: false)

name: aurora_get_ethics_log
description: Returns the tail of the GUMAS ethics audit log. Each entry records an ethics check event: protocol invocation, boundary check, coherence validation, or symbolic memory merge audit. Active protocol: Picard_Delta_3.

limit.description: Number of most recent entries to return (default: 20, max: 100)

name: aurora_get_capsules
description: Returns the Aurora capsule module registry. Reports load status, export readiness, and symbolic hash for all registered capsule modules. Capsule categories: Knowledge (Ev/In/B), SymbolicMemory Merge, Ethics Audit Log.

loaded_only.description: Return only currently loaded capsules (default: false)
